title: Hotel counter stool · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Counter stool, seat 0.76 m: firm foam seat and upholstered back in cobalt herringbone weave, tapered splayed walnut-stain legs with rungs, a brushed kick plate. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/). Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z.

title: Hotel lobby sofa, cloth-simulated · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse; upholstery texture by Poly Haven
description: Contract lobby sofa, 2.1 x 0.92 x 0.84 m: square track arms, two back cushions and two navy throw pillows inflated with Blender's cloth simulation (crowned faces, pinched seams, natural wrinkles, no two alike), two firm foam seat cushions worn into a slight sitting hollow, a walnut plinth on short feet. Upholstery is Poly Haven's poly_wool_herringbone (CC0) at its real 27 cm repeat; the frame is never dead flat. About 30k triangles. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/sofa.py). Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z.
